sentence: Hoje não faz sol nem calor.
ipa: ˈɔʒe ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈfas ˈsɔɫ ˈnẽj̃ kɐˈlor
gloss_en: Today it is neither sunny nor hot.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol' and open [ɔ] per goncalves1996; alveolar rhotic [r] in coda 'calor' per ferraz1979.

sentence: O bilhete custa cem dobras.
ipa: u biˈʎɛte ˈkustɐ ˈsẽj̃ ˈdɔbrɐs
gloss_en: The ticket costs a hundred dobras.
notes: Santomean currency 'dobra' per hagemeijer2009; palatal [ʎ] in 'bilhete' and alveolar trill [r] in 'dobras' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Tenho consulta na quinta-feira às nove horas.
ipa: ˈtɛɲu kõˈsuɫtɐ nɐ ˈkĩtɐ ˈfejrɐ as ˈnɔve ˈɔrɐs
gloss_en: I have an appointment on Thursday at nine.
notes: Palatal [ɲ] in 'tenho' and dark coda [ɫ] in 'consulta' per goncalves1996; retained /ej/ in 'feira' and alveolar [r] in 'horas' per ferraz1979.

sentence: A minha família mora numa roça antiga.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ fɐˈmiliɐ ˈmɔrɐ ˈnumɐ ˈʁɔsɐ ɐ̃ˈtiɡɐ
gloss_en: My family lives on an old plantation estate.
notes: Santomean lexicon 'roça' (plantation estate) central to island life per hagemeijer2009; strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'roça' and palatal [ɲ] in 'minha' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈvirɐ a diˈrejtɐ i ˈsɛɡe ˈsẽpre ẽj̃ ˈfrẽte
gloss_en: Turn right and keep going straight ahead.
notes: Retained /ej/ in 'direita' and alveolar trill [r] in the 'fr' cluster of 'frente' per ferraz1979; imperative register per goncalves1996.

sentence: Este calulu está muito bom com banana pão.
ipa: ˈeste kɐluˈlu eˈsta ˈmujtu ˈbõ kõ bɐˈnanɐ ˈpɐ̃w̃
gloss_en: This calulu is very good with plantain.
notes: Gulf-of-Guinea dish 'calulu' and 'banana pão' per hagemeijer2009; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'pão' and open nasal /o/ in 'bom' per goncalves1996.

sentence: Onde fica a praia mais perto?
ipa: ˈõde ˈfikɐ ɐ ˈprajɐ ˈmajs ˈpɛrtu
gloss_en: Where is the nearest beach?
notes: Alveolar trill [r] in 'perto', retained /ej/? no, open [ɛ] in 'perto' per ferraz1979; interrogative register per goncalves1996.

sentence: Quantas dobras custa o peixe fresco?
ipa: ˈkwɐ̃tɐs ˈdɔbrɐs ˈkustɐ u ˈpejʃe ˈfresku
gloss_en: How many dobras does the fresh fish cost?
notes: Santomean currency 'dobra' per hagemeijer2009; nasal [ɐ̃] in 'quantas', retained /ej/ in 'peixe' and alveolar trill [r] in 'fresco' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Se chovesse, ficávamos em casa.
ipa: se ʃoˈvɛs̺e fiˈkavɐmos ẽj̃ ˈkasɐ
gloss_en: If it rained, we would stay home.
notes: [ʃ] onset and open [ɛ] in 'chovesse' per goncalves1996; conditional-imperfect frame; alveolar rhotic system per ferraz1979.

sentence: Ontem comprei safu no mercado.
ipa: ˈõtẽj̃ kõˈprej sɐˈfu nu meˈrkadu
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought safu fruit at the market.
notes: Santomean fruit 'safu' per hagemeijer2009; retained /ej/ in 'comprei' and alveolar trill [r] in 'mercado' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Para o ano vou viajar até ao Príncipe.
ipa: ˈparɐ u ˈɐnu ˈvo viɐˈʒar ɐˈtɛ ɐu ˈprĩsipe
gloss_en: Next year I will travel to Principe.
notes: Santomean island name Principe per hagemeijer2009; open [ɛ] in 'até', /o/ monophthong in 'vou'->[ˈvo] and alveolar trill [r] in 'Príncipe' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Liga-me mais tarde, por favor.
ipa: ˈliɡɐ me ˈmajs ˈtarde por fɐˈvɔr
gloss_en: Call me later, please.
notes: Open [ɔ] in 'por'/'favor' and alveolar trill [r] in 'tarde' per ferraz1979; clitic imperative 'liga-me' per goncalves1996.

sentence: Olá, tudo leve-leve contigo?
ipa: oˈla ˈtudu ˈlɛve ˈlɛve kõˈtiɡu
gloss_en: Hello, are you taking it easy?
notes: Santomean catchphrase 'leve-leve' (easy does it), emblematic of the islands, per hagemeijer2009; open [ɛ] in 'leve' and full vowels per goncalves1996.

sentence: Quem não arrisca, não petisca.
ipa: ˈkẽj̃ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ɐˈriskɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ peˈtiskɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Alveolar trill [r] from 'rr' in 'arrisca' per ferraz1979; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'não'; proverb register per goncalves1996.

sentence: O carro velho ficou na estrada molhada.
ipa: u ˈkaru ˈvɛʎu fiˈko nɐ eˈstradɐ moˈʎadɐ
gloss_en: The old car ended up on the wet road.
notes: Alveolar trill [r] from 'rr' in 'carro' and palatal [ʎ] in 'velho'/'molhada' per ferraz1979; retained /ou/->[o] in 'ficou' per goncalves1996.

sentence: Ele trouxe um ramo de flores roxas.
ipa: ˈele ˈtrose ˈũ ˈʁamu de ˈflɔres ˈʁɔʃɐs
gloss_en: He brought a bunch of red flowers.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'ramo'/'roxas' and 'ou' diphthong in 'trouxe' per ferraz1979; open [ɔ] in 'roxas'/'flores' per goncalves1996.

sentence: Na gravana a terra fica seca e quente.
ipa: nɐ ɡrɐˈvanɐ ɐ ˈtɛrɐ ˈfikɐ ˈsɛkɐ i ˈkẽte
gloss_en: In the dry season the land goes dry and hot.
notes: Santomean 'gravana' (dry season) per hagemeijer2009; alveolar trill [r] in 'terra', open [ɛ] in 'terra'/'seca' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vende jornais na esquina.
ipa: ɐˈkɛle ʁɐˈpas ˈvẽde ʒoˈrnajs nɐ eˈskinɐ
gloss_en: That young man sells newspapers on the corner.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'rapaz', open [ɛ] in 'aquele' and alveolar [r] in 'jornais' per ferraz1979; register per goncalves1996.

sentence: O melhor cacau da ilha vem daquela roça.
ipa: u meˈʎɔr kɐˈkaw dɐ ˈiʎɐ ˈvẽj̃ dɐˈkɛlɐ ˈʁɔsɐ
gloss_en: The island's best cocoa comes from that estate.
notes: Santomean 'roça' (cocoa estate) and the island cocoa economy per hagemeijer2009; palatal [ʎ] in 'ilha' and /aw/ in 'cacau' per ferraz1979.

sentence: Nunca vi um céu tão azul sobre o mar.
ipa: ˈnũkɐ ˈvi ˈũ ˈsɛw ˈtɐ̃w̃ ɐˈzuɫ ˈsobre u ˈmar
gloss_en: I never saw such a blue sky over the sea.
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'tão', open [ɛ] in 'céu' and dark coda [ɫ] in 'azul' per goncalves1996; alveolar trill [r] in 'sobre'/'mar' per ferraz1979.
